يصطخد (form VIII)
# يَصْطَخِدُ (yaṣṭaḵidu) /jasˤ.tˤa.xi.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
# يُصْطَخَدُ (yuṣṭaḵadu) /jusˤ.tˤa.xa.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
# يَصْطَخِدَ (yaṣṭaḵida) /jasˤ.tˤa.xi.da/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
